name: Chaman Metallics Ltd.
summary: Chaman Metallics Ltd. is primarily engaged in the manufacturing and selling of Direct Reduced Iron, commonly known as sponge iron. This product serves as a crucial raw material for steel production, particularly in electric arc furnaces and induction furnaces. The company also produces dolochar as a by-product, which is utilized in power generation. Operating within the steel and metal industry, Chaman Metallics Ltd. maintains manufacturing facilities in Chandrapur, Maharashtra, and has additional plants across Chhattisgarh. The company is currently expanding its operations to include billets, ferro alloys, and captive power production, aiming to become a more integrated steel producer.
